comment: A third country to the common system of VAT of Directive 2006/112/EC,
article 5(2), which applies only in the territory of the Community as the
Treaties define it. Nicaragua levies its own Impuesto al Valor Agregado
under Ley No. 822, Ley de Concertación Tributaria, unrelated to the
Union's common system. `vat_prefix` is null: a Nicaraguan taxpayer is
identified by the Registro Único de Contribuyentes (RUC), which the
Dirección General de Ingresos assigns and which carries no ISO country
prefix comparable to an EU VAT number.
territories.name: Nicaragua
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and Nicaragua is a third country to it. Nicaragua levies a value added tax of its own, the Impuesto al Valor Agregado, under Ley No. 822, Ley de Concertación Tributaria, article 109, at a single rate of fifteen per cent (15 %) and a rate of zero per cent (0 %) on exports.
